propositions: Two modules (gerrit_client.py and workspace.py) contain network-capable git calls with no timeout, risking indefinite hangs on stuck remotes or hung credential helpers
TimeoutExpired exceptions in gerrit_client.clone_change_ref bypass the token-redaction handler because they are neither OSError nor CalledProcessError, creating a credential-disclosure path
ref_lock.py is already fully bounded via a required keyword-only timeout parameter on its single _git seam, requiring no edits
Both gerrit_client and workspace must define _GIT_TIMEOUT=300 and pass it to all subprocess.run calls, with timeout exceptions converted to module-specific errors naming the operation and bound
Two deferred call sites in _commands/init.py and _commands/fsck_repair.py are blocked on task 983f pending resolution of conflicting changes in task 01e8
